name: SoftEdgeFormat
description: Represents the soft edge formatting for a shape or range of shapes.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoBevelType constant that represents the bevel type for the edges of images that use soft edge formatting. Read/write.

properties.name: Radius
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the length of the radius for a soft edge effect. Read/write.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Word application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified SoftEdgeFormat object.
